title: rumohra miqueliana f. fimbriata
intro: Rumohra miqueliana f. fimbriata, commonly known as the Chinese Tassel Fern, is a plant species within the family Polypodiaceae. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties and is valued for its potential health benefits, which include treating fever, inflammation, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Rumohra miqueliana f. fimbriata are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and expectorant properties, which help to reduce fever, alleviate respiratory symptoms, and promote the expulsion of mucus. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
